label: prop:force-carrier-intertwining-correspondence
title: Force carrier $T_{p,q}$ acting on $n$-strand braid lands on Wedderburn channel $\lambda = (p, 1^{n-p})$
html:
When the torus-knot force carrier T_{p,q} applies to an n-strand molecular braid, the dominant non-trivial Wedderburn weight rests strictly on the intertwining partition:

  \lambda^{(T_{p,q})}
  \;=\;
  (p,\, 1, 1, \ldots, 1).

The embedding B_p \hookrightarrow B_n restricts the non-trivial permutation orbit precisely to size p. The corresponding partition must therefore allocate exactly one tied hook-like part of size p, leaving n-p free strands. Empirical evaluation on H_2 bound states verifies that T_{2,9} maps exclusively to (2,1,1) and T_{3,5} maps exclusively to (3,1).
